title: Vietnam shuts airports, evacuates thousands as Typhoon Bualoi nears
summary: Vietnam shut four coastal airports and evacuated over 15,000 people as Typhoon Bualoi, with winds of 133 km/h, approached central provinces on Sunday. The storm, faster and stronger than forecast, threatens floods, landslides, and coastal inundation. Heavy rains have already hit Hue and Quang Tri. Last year, Typhoon Yagi killed 300 people and caused $3.3 billion damage.
